description: This file defines the Affiliate model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, including methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve affiliate data and reports.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Model class for managing customer affiliate data within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Creates a new customer affiliate record in the database and optionally adds approval if configured.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing customer affiliate record in the database.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes a customer affiliate record and associated reports.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves the affiliate record for a specific customer.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Retrieves an affiliate record based on a tracking code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Adds a new affiliate report entry with IP and country data.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all reports associated with a specific customer.
